govdocs-archive_org-nsia-TarsikesJohnGMr: An FBI memorandum dated December 13, 1963, records what Mrs. John G. Tarsikes told the bureau. She identified a young man for investigators, three weeks after President Kennedy was killed in Dallas. Small witness memos like this one fill the early assassination files. Each one shows agents chasing identifications and tips while the case was still raw and unsettled.
